items.title: 揭秘“暗夜蜘蛛侠”如何将彼得·帕克化身为恐怖怪物

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260827/rVTVnwbuaFtEufC.jpg
最近，漫画的平行宇宙概念风靡一时，漫威的“终极宇宙”（Ultimate Universe）和 DC 的“绝对宇宙”（Absolute Universe）始终占据销量榜首。对于漫威来说，唯一的问题是他们刚刚在今年夏天结束了终极系列。接下来该往何处去？如何保持这种势头？答案似乎是将重心转向另一个全新的宇宙，但这一次的重点是在经典的漫威 IP 中注入恐怖元素。

其结果就是“午夜宇宙”（Midnight Universe），这是一个设定在扭曲版漫威宇宙中的新系列，标志性角色都经历了翻天覆地的改造。该系列的三大支柱之一是 Phillip Kennedy Johnson 和 ScieTronc 创作的《午夜蜘蛛侠》（Midnight Spider-Man）。当这位友好的邻家英雄被赋予彻头彻尾的“身体恐怖”改造时，会发生什么？为了找到答案，我们通过电子邮件采访了 Johnson。
打造漫威的午夜宇宙
首先，我们很好奇午夜宇宙的使命。这个项目与终极系列相比如何？它是否仍然是为了让创作者能够以主线漫威宇宙中不可能实现的方式进行大胆尝试？

“在与三位编剧、高级编辑以及漫威总裁 Dan Buckley 的初次会议上，我记得 Dan 说过最清晰的一句话是：‘恐怖坐前排，超级英雄坐后排’，”Johnson 表示。“我将其理解为许可，我们可以尽情发挥。我把它当作一部原创恐怖系列来创作，尊重蜘蛛侠故事的核心，但以顶级恐怖作品的形式重新讲述。这种‘恐怖’不仅体现在令人毛骨悚然的意象上，我希望在概念、氛围和主题相关性上也能像最优秀的恐怖故事那样给人以重击。”
当午夜宇宙公布时，一些粉丝最初表示反对，他们原本期望该系列会聚焦于刀锋战士（Blade）和午夜之子（Midnight Sons）等传统的超自然角色。这引发了一个问题——是否有讨论过聚焦于更传统的恐怖角色？Johnson 是否觉得重新诠释这些标志性英雄实际上是更有力的方法？
“漫威传统的超自然角色确实在谈话中出现过，我毫不怀疑他们会在某个时刻出现在我们的故事中，”Johnson 说。“但启动阶段的重点始终是漫威最经典、最具标志性的角色。当午夜宇宙的最初预告发布时，每个看到它的人都假设会有类似的后续公告：午夜之子、刀锋战士、暗夜狼人、月光骑士、德古拉之墓。每个人都以为自己知道接下来会发生什么，甚至都没有讨论过。”
“午夜宇宙不仅仅是贴在我们那些常规恐怖作品封面上的贴纸。它是对整个漫威宇宙的彻底重塑。”
Johnson 继续说道，“这正是我想看到的反应，对我来说，这证实了我们拥抱意料之外的事物是正确的。午夜宇宙不仅仅是贴在常规恐怖作品封面上的贴纸。它是对整个漫威宇宙的彻底重塑。如果我们用《刀锋战士》开启午夜宇宙，风险在于‘午夜刀锋’看起来会和 616 宇宙的刀锋战士非常相似。午夜刀锋不会给我们带来任何新东西，因为他一直就是那个样子。”

在终极宇宙中，创作者们可以在 Jonathan Hickman 建立的两年实时框架内自由讲述故事。午夜宇宙的方法又是怎样的？Johnson 是专注于讲述自己的故事，还是《午夜蜘蛛侠》、Hickman 与 Matteo Della Fonte 的《午夜 X 战警》（Midnight X-Men），以及 Benjamin Percy 与 Kev Walker 的《午夜神奇四侠》（Midnight Fantastic Four）正在构建一个更宏大的故事？

“目前我们都专注于让每个独立的故事尽善尽美，但我们在创作过程中有很多讨论，”Johnson 说。“这份工作最大的福利之一就是 Jonathan、Ben 和我几乎每天都会通过电话或短信讨论这些书。在合作之前我就是他们两位的粉丝，能看到他们的剧本并了解他们的创作过程是一种荣幸。我们都会跟踪彼此的故事进度，提供剧本和艺术图供反馈，并随时向对方通报可能在其他作品中有用的故事元素。这是一个真正的编剧室，参与其中是一件乐事。”
为午夜宇宙重塑蜘蛛侠
《午夜蜘蛛侠》重塑神话最明显的方式之一涉及那只放射性蜘蛛。这不再是彼得被小蜘蛛咬了一口，然后一夜之间变成超人类。这是一个漫长、痛苦且拖沓的转化过程，书中的身体恐怖元素体现在我们看到这只巨大的蛛形纲动物融合在他的胸口。那么，这种转化及其心理影响在 Kennedy 的早期故事中占据多大的比重？

“我必须小心不要剧透这只标志性蜘蛛到底是什么，以及它对彼得做了什么……这是一个我们将在系列过程中慢慢揭开的谜团，”Johnson 透露道。“我希望人们有自己的理论，并随着我们慢慢揭示彼得身上发生的事情，让这些理论不断升级和演变。但我可以说，每一期之间的身体恐怖升级是非常极端的。希望读者读到第 3 期时，会难以想象故事还能往什么方向发展。我们必须在故事的边缘科学上非常有创意，以确保从现在起 25 期、50 期甚至 100 多期后仍有恐怖的新景象可供探索。每当新一期上架时，我希望读者在下一期到来之前一直感到脊背发凉。”
以身体恐怖为核心的蜘蛛侠确实令人着迷。我们很好奇 Johnson 和 ScieTronc 是否从电影、漫画或动画中汲取了特定的灵感。
“在电影方面，对该系列影响最大的是大卫·柯南伯格、约翰·卡朋特和吉尔莫·德尔·托罗的作品，”Johnson 说。“德尔·托罗影响了我所做的一切……他是我最喜欢的创作者之一。我还要把 H.R. 吉格尔加入名单。尽管他在技术上不被视为电影制作人，但没有吉格尔就没有《异形》。他的作品模糊了生物学、技术、性欲和最恐怖的身体恐怖之间的界限，他的作品将一直启发《午夜蜘蛛侠》的画面直到结束。”

至于漫画，Johnson 说：“许多最大的影响来自恐怖漫画或恐怖动作作品：主要是伟大的伊藤润二的作品，还有《异变者》（Homunculus）、《寄生兽》、《电锯人》等。在西方漫画中，目光敏锐的读者会看到 Garcia 和 Rubin 的《贝奥武夫》改编版的影响，我认为那是一部天才之作。还有 Bendis 和 Oeming 的《超能力者》（Powers）。我也在留意之前出现过的漫威和 DC 的‘宇宙重塑’作品：Bendis 的《终极蜘蛛侠》和《新复仇者联盟》，Hickman 最近的《终极蜘蛛侠》，以及《绝对蝙蝠侠》、《神奇女侠》等。我们在午夜宇宙中所做的事情与这些都非常不同，但它们都执行得非常好，在我们探索午夜宇宙的过程中有很多经验可以借鉴。”

Johnson 补充道：“此外，说起来可能有点奇怪，但 ScieTronc 的艺术风格可能对我创作《午夜蜘蛛侠》的影响最大。他的画作完全塑造了我为他撰写剧本的方式。ScieTronc 作品中的漫画影响一目了然：它具有漫画擅长的面部表情和动态动作，但也有极高水平的细节、渲染、环境趣味和西方顶级漫画所具备的创意布局。如果我是为其他艺术家创作，故事会完全不同。我必须在某些方面自学，以确保我给他的剧本能最好地体现他的风格和技能。”
虽然彼得·帕克与诺曼·奥斯本的持久恩怨一直是该系列的标志，但《午夜蜘蛛侠》似乎扩大了这一范围，并加倍强化了这位孤独义警与亿万富翁寡头阶级之间的冲突。该系列无疑涉足了当下热门话题，但《午夜蜘蛛侠》如何为 2026 年重新定义“能力与责任”这一主题？
“蜘蛛侠的使命宣言一直是‘能力越大，责任越大’，”Johnson 说。“但在 2026 年创作蜘蛛侠——尤其是《午夜蜘蛛侠》——我们必须承认，我们生活的世界几乎完全反驳了这一前提。在 2026 年，一个更真实的说法是：权力造就怪物。”

Johnson 继续说道，“《午夜蜘蛛侠》是这两个原则的碰撞。彼得·帕克是一个聪明但受挫的孩子，渴望个人转变，他需要‘能力与责任’是真实的，并以此方式生活来证明这一点。尽管困难重重，他获得了展示力量和伟大的机会……但就像其他权势人物一样，他的力量以恐怖、怪异的方式改变了他。在整个系列中，他否认这一点，他与之抗争，即使人性离他越来越远，他也拼命想要抓住它。我们将用整个系列来回答哪个版本的彼得最终会获胜的问题。”
《午夜蜘蛛侠》第 1 期、《午夜 X 战警》第 1 期和《午夜神奇四侠》第 1 期都将于 2026 年 10 月 7 日发布。

Massive Entertainment，全境封锁2 的开发商，在 Gamescom 的社区小组会议上宣布了这款长线运营的在线动作 RPG/第三人称射击游戏的新 DLC。这一新资料片名为 Echoes of Central Park，并将于 9 月 24 日进行全面揭晓。
全境封锁2
第三人称射击, 动作, PVP, 探索
说起《全境封锁》，玩家朋友们想到的可能是掉线，缩水之类的负面形象，但实际上《全境封锁》有着相当出色的游戏内容，只不过之前育碧这个步子没有迈好，这次的《全境封锁2》在吸取前作的各种经验教训后，想必会变得更加出色。

这款以曼哈顿为背景的服务型游戏将因公园内部发出的求救信号，最终进军中央公园。Echoes 承诺将带来笼罩在恐惧与神秘之中的阴暗基调，无论是玩家还是他们的游戏角色，都不确定里面有什么，也不清楚自疫情爆发以来中央公园变成了什么样。
Massive 承诺该 DLC 将拥有极高的可重复游玩性，包括一些能赋予游戏独特体验的“新花样”。谈到玩法，开发商也希望在这里更侧重于游戏性，而不仅仅是新的故事内容。具体将如何呈现还有待观察。

我是多年的 幽浮:奇美拉战队 粉丝，虽然我们已经很久没有迎来新作了，但 Star Wars Zero Company 似乎是一个完美的替代品。它设定在星战宇宙中，这太棒了，而且将其置于克隆战争中期，使其成为了这类战术游戏的绝佳舞台。虽然到目前为止我玩得很开心，但它也饱受性能问题的困扰，就像大约一个月前的 Halo Campaign Evolved 一样。

在撰写本文时，我在 Star Wars Zero Company 中的体验简直是一场噩梦，充满了崩溃和掉帧。我确信随着时间的推移，游戏会通过补丁变得更加稳定，但就目前而言，它对中低端硬件并不友好。甚至在性能极其强悍的 RTX 5090 游戏 PC 上，我也遇到了一些问题。
Star Wars Zero Company PC 设置
虽然你可以通过调整设置让 Star Wars Zero Company 在大多数时间运行得更顺畅，但掉帧问题依然存在，特别是在过场动画中。即使你能让游戏稳定在 60fps，偶尔还是会出现卡顿。解决这一问题的最佳方法之一是拥有一台处理器性能强劲的 PC。

当我尝试在 Lenovo Legion Go 2 之类的设备上运行游戏时，CPU 占用率会维持在 50–60% 左右，而 GPU 占用率则在 70–80%，这显然浪费了性能。Nvidia Reflex 和 AMD FSR Anti-Lag 有一定帮助，但在大多数情况下，性能瓶颈在于 CPU。即使在配备 Ryzen 7 9850X3D 和 RTX 5090 的台式机上，游戏偶尔也会将 CPU 占用率飙升至 50%，通常是在任务开始时。
使用虚幻引擎 5 (Unreal Engine 5) 开发的游戏很难调优，但如果你知道该从哪里下手，还是能挤出一些额外性能的。我将详细介绍所有设置及其影响，以便你根据自己的 PC 配置进行优化。例如，如果你的 CPU 较弱，你可能需要首先降低“隐藏物体细节”和“特效质量”等选项。

窗口模式 (Windowing Mode)： 更改游戏运行时的窗口显示方式。只有三个选项：全屏 (Fullscreen) 会让电脑仅渲染游戏，但在切换窗口 (Alt-Tab) 时可能会出问题。无边框窗口 (Borderless Window) 是我所谓的“伪全屏”，它占满整个屏幕，同时在后台渲染 Windows 桌面。窗口化 (Windowed) 模式则将游戏放在标准窗口中，可以看到任务栏。单显示器建议选全屏，多显示器或经常切换窗口建议选无边框。
抗锯齿与缩放 (Anti-Aliasing and Upscaling)： 过去人们曾争论该用哪种缩放技术，但现在我建议根据显卡品牌来选。AMD 用户选 FSR，Nvidia 用户选 DLSS，Intel GPU 用户选 XeSS。对于这款游戏，我建议几乎所有人都开启某种缩放技术以最大化性能。
缩放质量 (Upscaling Quality)： 更改游戏缩放的比例。幸运的是，各显卡厂商使用的比例相同，建议根据你的原生分辨率来选择。我的经验法则是：4K 选性能 (Performance)，1440p 选平衡 (Balanced)，1080p 选质量 (Quality)。
帧生成 (Frame Generation)： 使用 AI 生成新帧并插入原生渲染帧之间，从而提高帧率。这会增加延迟，但对于 Star Wars Zero Company 这种回合制游戏来说，延迟并不重要。如果你想要更流畅的画面，请开启它。
Nvidia Reflex/AMD Anti-Lag/XeSS LL： 设置名称取决于显卡，但底层技术相似。它们会清空渲染队列，仅在 CPU 将帧交付给显卡时才进行渲染，从而降低延迟。没有任何理由不开启它。
阴影质量 (Shadow Quality)： 如果受限于 GPU 性能且帧数不足，阴影通常是我第一个削减的项目。这会影响阴影的精确度，即使在低档位，画面看起来也还凑合（虚幻引擎在扩展性上确实有点问题）。 中端 PC：高；掌机：低
全局光照 (Global Illumination)： 更改间接光照的质量。这是另一个主要影响显卡的设置，如果受限于 GPU 性能请调低它。但如果你的显卡利用率甚至没达到 100%，这可能不是导致性能问题的原因。请注意，“高”和“最高”设置会启用光线追踪，因此从中档调至高档会大幅增加 GPU 负担。 中端 PC：中；掌机：低
反射 (Reflections)： 与全局光照类似，反射也主要受限于 GPU，且 Bit Reactor 在这里也使用了光线追踪。作为一款科幻游戏，场景中有很多反射表面，因此这对性能影响很大，尤其是在低端显卡上。除非你有高端卡，否则建议保持在中档。 中端 PC：中；掌机：低
后处理 (Post Processing)： 我对后处理效果爱恨交织，不太满意 Bit Reactor 把所有效果都揉进了一个设置里。这会改变从动态模糊到泛光的所有效果。老实说，这不会对性能产生太大影响，但如果你讨厌动态模糊，为了避免头晕，值得把它调低。 中端 PC：随你喜欢；掌机：随你喜欢
纹理 (Textures)： 更改纹理渲染的分辨率。这主要影响显存 (VRAM)，请据此调整。建议在任务期间开启性能监视器，观察显存占用情况，仅在接近上限时才调低。如果显存在 10GB 以上，选最高；如果少于 8GB，选平衡或低。
特效质量 (Effect Quality)： 更改视觉特效的细节，包括爆炸、碎片和激光等。这会加重 CPU 负担，如果你遇到 CPU 瓶颈，应该削减此项。 中端 PC：高；掌机：低
着色质量 (Shading Quality)： 在本作中，着色质量基本等同于网格质量，会改变场景中物体的细节程度。与纹理类似，如果显存不足，请调低此项。 中端 PC：高；掌机：低
视距 (View Distance)： 在这款游戏中加入这个设置有点滑稽。它只会改变你能看到多远处的物体细节。由于大多数地图都很小，这纯粹是审美选择，所以我倾向于在调整其他设置之前先调低它。 中端 PC：中；掌机：低
隐藏物体细节 (Hidden Objects Detail)： 更改当前隐藏物体的细节。这会消耗 CPU 性能，如果遇到瓶颈请调低。 中端 PC：简化；掌机：简化
环境几何细节 (Environment Geometry Detail)： 这是一个改变场景中模型几何形状的开关。Bit Reactor 的提示称，较新的显卡关闭此项不会获得明显的性能收益，因此除非你的电脑已经超过 5 年，否则建议保持开启。 中端 PC：开启；掌机：关闭

items.title: Xbox 25 周年限量版主机售价及发售日期公布，附赠 Halo: Campaign Evolved

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260827/rvFEjnbuaFsmnAw.jpg
Xbox公布了其25周年限量版主机的价格和发售日期，并且还附赠了一款免费游戏。
今年夏天早些时候，微软透露将为公司成立25周年推出一款受初代Xbox启发设计的半透明绿色Xbox Series X主机。现在，微软已确认该主机售价高达899.99美元，并将于11月13日发售。套装包含Xbox Series X主机、一个匹配的控制器，以及一份免费的 Halo: Campaign Evolved。预售将于太平洋时间明天（8月27日）上午7点开启。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260827/XKzEzFbuaFsmsBd.png
控制器可单独购买，售价79.99美元，将于10月20日发售。如果你正打算购买一台全新的Xbox，这笔交易还算不错。带光驱的Xbox Series X本身售价为799.99美元。这款限量版多花了100美元，但包含了Xbox今年最重磅的游戏之一。然而，下一代Xbox也可能即将到来。微软在今年早些时候证实，将于今年晚些时候公布代号为“Project Helix”的新主机的详细信息。
如果下一代Xbox在2027年秋季发布，这并不令人意外，因为微软已经暗示那个时间点对公司非常重要。该公司还公布了一项新的“光盘转数字”功能计划，允许用户获取其Xbox One和Xbox Series X实体版游戏的数字副本。据推测，这是为了让玩家为过渡到更侧重数字版的下一代主机做好准备。

items.title: Rockstar 警告玩家谨防剧透仅数小时后，爆料者发布 GTA6 序章长段实机演示

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260827/qTrgLibuaFsmmnx.webp
揭示 GTA6 剧情序幕的加长版演示视频已在网上发布，这标志着过去一周持续不断的泄密事件发生了重大升级。
GTA6
动作冒险, 角色扮演
PC 玩家们，我知道你们很急，但你们先 别 急。
查看更多 立即下载
一段时长超过四分钟、以 GTA6 角色露西亚（Lucia）为主角的实机演示正在社交媒体上传播，这是首次泄露的揭示关键剧情细节的长篇视频。如果你计划在没有任何剧情剧透的情况下体验 GTA6，那么在接下来的几天和几周内，请务必留意你在网上的点击。
该视频发布前几小时，Rockstar 终于打破了对泄密事件的沉默，称这对开发团队来说是“令人心碎的”。在今天早些时候发布的在线声明中，开发商警告粉丝，剧透可能会影响他们原本希望玩家首次体验游戏的方式——现在看来，这一点确实应验了。
泄密者在最新视频的水印中发表了一份新声明，对 GTA6 的开发提出了一些未经证实的说法，例如游戏仍未完成，以及在 11 月 19 日发售日期之前，游戏还有“太多”工作要做，无法轻松完成。
今天早些时候，Rockstar 指出他们确实仍在开发这款游戏——考虑到距离发售还有近三个月的时间，这完全在预料之中——但目前已“接近”完成。该公司还重申了 GTA6 将于 11 月 19 日发售，表明了对日期不会改变的信心。
泄密者还声称拥有游戏的“近期”版本，这同样无法证实。然而，毫无疑问，这些泄密内容源自一个经过打磨的可玩版本。泄密者究竟是如何获得该版本的仍是一个谜，但 Rockstar 及其母公司 Take-Two 正在积极采取措施进行查证。
最后，泄密者再次呼吁以其发行的加密货币形式提供“支持”，这被广泛视为一种敛财行为。或许预示着他们的泄密生涯即将结束，泄密者表示 $Cyberleek 币的“交易量/价格”将决定是否继续发布视频。
在过去的一周里，网上出现了十几个实机演示片段，从 Rockstar 的角度来看，这造成了重大损失，因为 GTA6 世界的许多部分现已被揭露。据彭博社报道，由于泄密已持续一周，Rockstar 正在全力调查这些泄密事件是如何发生的，以及幕后黑手是谁。
然而，前 Rockstar Games 技术总监 Obbe Vermeij 淡化了泄密造成的损害。Vermeij 曾于 1995 年至 2009 年在 Rockstar North 工作，他在社交媒体上表示，公司过去经历过更糟糕的情况，例如“热咖啡”丑闻。
当然，这一切都发生在 Rockstar Games 自己通过 GTA6 Extended Look 揭晓 GTA6 实机演示的前一天。这段详尽的官方首秀将在 Netflix 上独家播出六小时，然后再登陆 YouTube 等其他平台。

items.title: 《Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy》评测

others.title: I got my greasy mitts on a host of RTX Spark laptops running, what else, games at Gamescom 2026—and there's a couple I really want to take home
Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy Review
Review: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy (PS5) - Solid Story Game without the Rats

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260827/wnKwAgbuaFsmlkt.jpg

我通常更欣赏冒险的新创意，而非稳妥的续作，因此我对没有标志性食人鼠群的瘟疫传说系列会是什么样子非常感兴趣。虽然 Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy 进行了许多有趣的改变，例如聚焦于不同的主角和全新的配角阵容，但大多数改动都使其未能达到前作那样的魅力。这个前传故事从鼠群大军转向了更古老、未被探索的恐怖，但这些内容并没有达到系列的高标准。从一个厌恶冲突的孩子进行潜行，转变为在近战格斗中直接用刀杀人，这种转变在战斗本身过于简陋的情况下，很难支撑起这 12 小时的流程。即便如此，简单但有趣的谜题、华丽的环境以及后期出现的紧张潜行环节仍然基本值得一玩，但总体而言，这部外传感觉退步多于进步。

Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy 沿用了你可能已经熟悉的第三人称冒险模式。按照 星球大战绝地：幸存者 或 战神：诸神黄昏 等这类“钻缝模拟器”的传统，你将带着同伴穿过一系列小型战斗竞技场和解谜房间，在互相打趣中慢慢展开故事。这大部分感觉与之前的瘟疫传说游戏非常相似，但有一些显著的例外：Hugo 和 Amicia 被 瘟疫传说：安魂曲 中的配角之一 Sophia 取代，潜行机制也大部分换成了此类游戏中常见的典型第三人称近战格斗。不幸的是，和许多同类游戏一样，它也有那种令人恼火的设计：在你踏入房间仅几秒钟后，角色就会立即喊出每个谜题的解决方案——好在可以关闭这个选项，我毫不犹豫地立刻关掉了它。

虽然 Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy 的故事是其强项之一，但仍不及瘟疫传说系列的其他作品。故事始于一场类似 UNCHARTED™: 盗贼传奇合辑 的寻宝之旅，随后演变成一个恐怖的末日场景，反映了许多与 瘟疫传说：无罪 和 瘟疫传说：安魂曲 相同的主题，但在角色塑造上的用心程度明显不足。感觉他们像是想快进完成 Sophia 的背景故事，她在 瘟疫传说：安魂曲 中是一个相当扁平的角色。在那部作品中，她是一个有着金子般心肠的通用局外人，没有太多成长弧光，因此 Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy 在充实她的形象方面承担了相当大的重任。它在这方面的成功非常有限——在亲身体验了她的悲惨故事后，我确实更了解她、更关心她了，但也发现她依然没有真正的性格弧光，开始和结束时都是那个追求宝藏的流氓，这让我感到困惑。在我引导她经历了终身的创伤之后，这感觉有点不对劲。
相反，你揭开的古代历史实际上比 Sophia 的个人旅程更有回报。通过闪回揭示的碎片化信息解开了她寻宝核心——那个早已消亡的文明的谜团。这些片段中的角色、反转和对话比寻宝本身更吸引我。到最后，感觉 Sophia 更像是一个随行的配角（就像她在 瘟疫传说：安魂曲 中那样），而不是焦点。

配角也存在许多与 Sophia 相同的问题，比如 Leni，一个迷信运气的扒手，虽然一直跟着但从没说过什么有趣的话；或者是你海盗船的船长 Faro，他唯一的讨喜之处就是他在旅途的每个阶段都是个彻头彻尾的笨蛋。尽管花了不少时间与这些人一起解谜和聊天，但他们并没有像我希望的那样让我产生好感，即使 Faro 那滑稽糟糕的发型确实让我每次看到都想笑。这真正凸显了 Hugo 和 Amicia 之间的关系在其他瘟疫传说游戏中是多么至关重要，而这套阵容并没能有效地填补这一空白。他们本身并不坏，但没能像我所期待的那些注重故事的游戏那样留下深刻印象。
你揭开的历史实际上比 Sophia 的个人旅程更有回报。

这部前传衍生作最大的区别在于，你不再是绕过那些你无法伤害的重甲敌人，而是手持长剑坚守阵地，在战场上进行招架和躲闪，在简单、重复的遭遇战中消灭敌人。从潜行到全面战斗的转变并不是最无缝的——虽然不至于糟糕，但始终显得浅薄且有时很草率。只有标准的轻重攻击、破防的踢腿，以及只有两三种不同攻击方式的少数几种敌人。在有趣的谜题之间，大量时间都花在了这些幽闭恐怖的竞技场中，但战斗深度如此匮乏，以至于几乎立刻就让人感到单调，难以维持兴趣。我只想尽快完成这些平淡的遭遇战，回到更出色的故事和谜题中去。

你至少拥有一个技能树，偶尔可以购买新的强化项目，比如让你能击退敌人的更强力的踢腿，或者在击杀敌人后获得暂时的伤害保护。但这些大多是适度的升级，能让战斗快一点结束，却没能增加趣味性。滑稽的是，Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy 偶尔会引入新机制来改变战斗节奏，比如无法招架的红色闪光攻击，但随后又在技能树中提供升级，让你能够……招架那些红色攻击，在功能上移除了那个新机制，让战斗保持过度简单。

在战斗间隙，当你解决该系列一直以来闻名的光影谜题时，你会得到一个受欢迎的喘息机会。这些无疑是冒险中最令人愉快的部分，尽管其中许多都是超级简单的光线反射谜题，你需要移动镜子将光束指向门。我可能玩过上百个有着完全相同谜题的游戏，虽然我不需要 Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy 在这里开辟大量新天地，但与瘟疫传说其他作品中让你清除鼠群路径的巧妙方式相比，它们确实感觉有点退步。即便如此，当谜题奏效时（大约有一半的时间），像夺宝奇兵那样四处搜寻古迹并从旧日记中拼凑线索还是很有趣的。

值得庆幸的是，随着后期鼠群的恐怖最终被一种新型危险所取代，这些高光时刻变得更加频繁。我不会在这里剧透，但某些章节回归了那种你无法正面对抗的敌人类型，迫使你发挥创意进行逃脱。正如你所料，你通过将光线反射到黑暗区域来对抗这个新问题，所以有些谜题还是你之前做过的那些缺乏新意的东西——但因为赌注更高，而且智取敌人的过程比单纯开门要刺激得多，这些章节立刻显得有趣且原创，而故事的大部分遭遇战都缺乏这种感觉。这类内容一直是瘟疫传说系列最擅长的，引入一种新的恐惧感非常棒，即使你不得不忍受其间不断发生的那些索然无味的战斗。

items.title: 亮相 gamescom 和 PAX West 的 6 款 indie.io 游戏，现已在 Steam 提供免费试玩版

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260827/HUpdUSbuaFqvljr.png
发行平台 indie.io 将在接下来的几周内参加科隆游戏展（gamescom）和 PAX West 游戏展，并带来六款游戏供玩家现场试玩。如果你无法亲临现场，也不必担心：这六款游戏现在都已在 Steam 上推出了免费试玩版，无需门票即可体验。
延续 indie.io 的一贯风格，这些游戏涵盖了多种类型，从温馨的葡萄园庄园建造到残酷的回合制 Roguelite RPG 应有尽有。无论你偏好哪种类型，总有一款适合你，现在就可以前往体验。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260827/cFqoYRbuaFqCyzh.png
Monster Park Tycoon
这款游戏此前曾以 Monster Zoo Tycoon 之名亮相，并于 8 月 10 日正式更名，但开发团队和核心玩法保持不变。在由 OverPowered Team 开发的 Monster Park Tycoon 中，你需要建造并管理一座怪物公园，吸引游客前来参观各种奇异而恐怖的怪物。但这里有个反转：你的公园其实是邪教的掩护，而且这个邪教看起来不太聪明。
为了扩张公园，你需要利用伪装成公园设施的陷阱来欺骗并抓捕游客。一旦得手，你可以将他们喂给怪物，洗脑成信徒，或者将他们献祭以获取“虔诚值”，从而解锁黑暗主宰的恩赐。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260827/QwvAoWbuaFqDjuF.jpg
不同的怪物有不同的饮食需求（如大脑、血液或灵魂）、展区环境要求，如果被忽视，它们的行为可能会演变成麻烦。随着怪物数量的增加，难免会有一些怪物突破束缚，届时场面将陷入混乱。因此，在这款充满黑色幽默的模拟经营游戏中，你需要一边控制混乱，一边努力壮大你的公园和邪教。
Monster Park Tycoon 在 Steam 上推出了全新的试玩版，这是开发团队以外的玩家首次有机会体验这款游戏。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260827/KqxgdubuaFrekAk.png
Dunebound Tactics
在这款 Roguelite 游戏中，你将参与回合制战术战斗，带领一群幸存者穿越险恶的沙漠寻找新家园。你的飞船非常脆弱，而名为 Elios 的关键资源也非常有限。在穿越沙丘的过程中，你可以通过完成任务、击败敌人来收集 Elios；如果情况变得万分紧急，你甚至可以牺牲船员。
这是一款 Roguelite 游戏，所以失败是常态。但每一次尝试都是在为下一次奠定基础。每当车队被摧毁，你将带着新的车队重新开始。你可以找到前一次探险的残骸，从中获得强化船员的模块，甚至找回前一次探险的幸存者。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260827/huDYfcbuaFrgBEk.png
你的船员拥有 15 种职业和 16 种独特特质，这决定了他们的技能和属性。战斗在网格地图上进行，你可以利用掩体，且地形是完全可破坏的。因此，你可以根据自己的优势改造地形，智取敌人。
Dunebound Tactics 此前曾在 Steam 新品节亮相，随后开发者 Terahard Ltd. 根据玩家反馈重制了试玩版。用开发者的话说：“如果你最近没玩过这个 Demo，它已经不再是你记忆中的那个样子了。”你现在可以在 Steam 上体验这个全新的改进版试玩版。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260827/CrjkVUbuaFrlcwj.png
We Took That Trip
与前两款游戏风格迥异，由 Lucito Loquito 开发的 We Took That Trip 是一款平静治愈的公路旅行游戏。这里没有计时器或截止日期，也没有必须完成的宏大任务。只有你和你的猫，开着面包车旅行，结识新朋友。
游戏提供三种模式：剧情模式、禅意模式和后台模式。剧情模式讲述了一个关于友谊、失去与重逢的温馨故事；禅意模式则纯粹是为了享受氛围，没有明确目标地漫游；后台模式是一种挂机模式，系统会自动为你驾驶，让你尽情享受视觉效果和低保真（lo-fi）原声带。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260827/UvIgqhbuaFrspCi.png
每次旅行都是程序生成的，时长由你决定，因此每次旅程都独一无二。沿途散布着加油站、商店和瞭望塔等兴趣点，你可以在那里遇到不同的人并聆听他们的故事。但游戏的焦点始终是道路和你的微型巴士，你可以用油漆、贴纸和其他装饰品来自定义它的内外装饰。
如果你想在漫长的一天后寻找一种平和的减压方式，可以去 Steam 查看这款试玩版。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260827/AbkiTObuaFrtpBE.png
Cozy Builder
由 Pangea Game Studios 开发的沙盒建筑模拟游戏 Cozy Builder 延续了这种轻松的氛围。你将从零开始，恢复“葡萄园谷”往日的荣光。你将使用模块化的建筑组件来建造你的庄园，采摘葡萄、草药和野花来酿造自己的葡萄酒或其他商品，与镇民分享或出售以继续资助你的庄园建设。
庄园拥有海量的自定义选项，包括室内的各种艺术品和家具，以及室外的花园、露台和温室。你可以将温室与家相连，为你提供一个培育花卉和收集稀有植物的场所。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260827/kHUsgNbuaFrtuwi.jpg
你可以独自完成这一切，也可以在多人模式中与朋友共同打造一个共享空间，展示各自的创造力。该试玩版在整个夏天都在不断更新，增加了诸如破坏模式下一键移动物品和完整的按键重绑定等新功能。你可以在 Steam 上亲身体验。
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/mayday-the-survival-island-key-art-1787602371901.png
Mayday: The Survival Island
在这款由 Pequi Studios 开发的开放世界生存建造游戏中，你在一次神秘的坠机后独自在荒岛上醒来。你受伤了，迷失了方向，周围是未开发的荒野，你必须找到生存之道。为此，你需要收集资源、制作工具、狩猎野生动物、捕鱼、种植庄稼，并建造一个家园，在努力查明真相的同时维持生计。
事实证明，你搁浅的岛屿是组成群岛的 24 个岛屿之一。你的冒险将带你前往所有岛屿，每个岛屿都有不同的环境、资源和隐藏的宝藏。因此，你需要不断升级工具，并学会适应每个岛屿的挑战。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260827/HpARdnbuaFsffos.jpg
游戏中没有限时目标或线性路线，故事的展开节奏完全由你决定。如果你想花几个小时建造基地、饲养动物和照料庄稼，完全没问题。或者你也可以只寻找生存必需品，然后继续推进剧情。
Mayday: The Survival Island 的故事聚焦于岛屿的秘密以及你为何会出现在这里。你会发现奇怪的符号、魔法图腾和失落文明的碎片，这些都暗示着这些岛屿并非表面看上去那么简单。随着探索的深入，你会开始质疑来到这里是否真的是场意外，以及是否真的有可能逃离。你可以通过 Steam 上的免费试玩版初窥端倪。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260827/SIVjbpbuaFsmare.png
Esports Manager 2026
名单上的最后一款游戏是唯一已经正式发布的，但你仍然可以在 Steam 上玩到免费试玩版。由 Neurona Games 开发的 Esports Manager 2026 于 7 月发布并取得了成功，最高同时在线人数超过 10,000 人，并登上了 Steam 的热门新品榜单。
正如标题所示，这是一款模拟经营游戏，你将掌控一家电竞组织的日常运营。你需要物色选手、签约员工、管理合同、培养人才、提升品牌影响力，并带领你的队伍在锦标赛中对抗顶尖对手。你可以接管现有的组织，也可以从头开始创建自己的组织，甚至可以招募和培养真实的电竞选手。
在锦标赛期间，你将在模拟模式中指挥队伍，控制战术并实时应对赛场突发事件。近期游戏发布了一次重大内容更新，重构了租借系统，重做了模拟模式中的地图，并允许退役选手转职为教练和分析师。
随着更新，游戏还开启了 25% 的折扣优惠，将持续到 9 月 8 日。如果你感兴趣，现在正是尝试试玩版并决定是否入手的最佳时机。

哈利波特：魁地奇冠军 电影明星鲁伯特·格林特将于明年再次饰演罗恩·韦斯莱，他将加入百老汇舞台剧《哈利波特：魁地奇冠军与被诅咒的孩子》的演员阵容。

格林特是第二位回归饰演《被诅咒的孩子》中童年角色的 哈利波特：魁地奇冠军 电影演员。这部由 J.K. 罗琳创作的官方剧集延续了系列多年后的故事，讲述了 哈利波特：魁地奇冠军 和罗恩的孩子们在霍格沃茨上学的故事。
去年，德拉科·马尔福的扮演者汤姆·费尔顿以这位深受粉丝喜爱的斯莱特林角色身份回归，极大地提高了百老汇演出的关注度。现在，该剧的制作人似乎热衷于再次上演同样的戏码，而格林特的年龄也刚好适合扮演成为年轻父亲的罗恩。
“从 11 岁起，罗恩·韦斯莱就是我的一部分，我迫不及待地想在这个人生阶段再次与他相遇，”格林特通过《好莱坞报道》表示，“在我们都为人父的当下，重新穿上罗恩的鞋子，这种感觉非常圆满且特别；这在某种程度上既非常熟悉又完全陌生。能回到百老汇，并出演一个定义了我大部分人生的角色，这种喜悦真的很令人兴奋。”
格林特将于 2027 年 2 月 2 日开始回归饰演罗恩，最初租期为 17 周，直到 5 月 30 日。然而，这确实意味着他在剧组的时间遗憾地不会与费尔顿重叠，后者多次延长的演出期限将于 2027 年 1 月 3 日结束。
虽然格林特仍以其在 哈利波特：魁地奇冠军 中的角色而闻名，但这位演员一直活跃在一系列影视项目中，例如 Apple TV 的恐怖剧集《灵异女仆》、M·奈特·沙马兰的电影《敲开后门》，以及今年即将上映、由约翰尼·德普主演的《埃比尼泽》，他在其中饰演鲍勃·克拉奇特。

制作人索尼娅·弗里德曼和科林·卡伦德在声明中表示：“加入我们在纽约市抒情剧院的非凡团队，鲁伯特不仅仅是在重温过去的一个角色。他正在延续他儿时开始的旅程，并带着自电影拍摄结束以来所获得的所有生活经历继续前进，包括他从电影到电视，再到百老汇和西区广受好评的舞台作品的职业生涯。他的回归在观众最初爱上的故事与《哈利波特：魁地奇冠军与被诅咒的孩子》所承载的关于家庭、遗产和时间流逝的故事之间架起了一座强有力的桥梁。”
当然，新一代的年轻演员很快将在 HBO 的 哈利波特：魁地奇冠军 电视剧重启版中接手 哈利波特：魁地奇冠军、罗恩和德拉科的角色。该剧定于今年圣诞节开播，将在未来十年内对该系列进行改编。

items.title: 《疯狂出租车: World Tour》还原了经典的 YA YA YA YA YA，但在“世界巡回”的“世界”部分栽了跟头 —— G…

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260827/RjxVqJbuaFndacb.jpg
预览核心要点：

世嘉 Dreamcast 时代最经典的代表作之一，莫过于街机驾驶游戏 疯狂出租车，它首次发布至今已超过四分之一个世纪。凭借其极赞的配乐和疯狂的驾驶体验，它几乎是“2000年代初期”电子游戏的精髓。距离该系列上一部作品发布已过去 12 年，而距离上一次登陆家用机平台更是已经过去了两倍的时间。最近，世嘉邀请我们试玩了在今年夏季游戏节上首次公开的新作：疯狂出租车: World Tour。伴随着 The Offspring 乐队高喊着“YA YA YA YA YA”，我猛踩油门去接第一位乘客。虽然对现状基本满意，但我希望它能更名副其实地展现出“World Tour（环球旅行）”的特色。
最近在 GamesCom 上公开了一个全新关卡：德国。这个新关卡具备了 疯狂出租车 这种快节奏街机游戏所需的大部分元素。我被传送到一个大型机场的停机坪上，这里是熟悉出租车操控感和练习漂移甩尾的绝佳场所。障碍物巨大的体积也让它们在大多数情况下都很容易避开。当我完成在机场区域的乘客接送任务后，便开始探索关卡的其余部分。
该区域分为五个部分：起始点的机场、城市、围城、山区，以及连接所有区域的无限速高速公路（Autobahn）。虽然我不确定机场如何能体现“德国”特色，但其他区域，尤其是城市地带，确实散发出了一点德意志风情。World Tour 中一个比较巧妙的设计是，玩家可以随时进入菜单更改时间，选项包括早晨、下午、傍晚或夜晚。
除了视觉美感的变化，我并没有注意到这种时间切换对玩法有任何影响，无论是乘客数量、交通密度还是随机任务的出现。我也没有注意到时间自然流逝的过程，但这可能只是因为试玩时间太短。希望在正式版游戏中，当玩家四处驾驶时，太阳能自然升起落下，因为每个时间段都有其独特的美感，而且我不介意时间段会影响区域的反馈。无论如何，在黄昏的黄金时刻或是在夜晚的灯火辉煌中穿梭，感觉确实很棒。

说到驾驶，作为 疯狂出租车 系列的基石，World Tour 的操控感非常出色，让我能完成急转弯、在斜坡上加速飞跃，并在车流中快速闪避。加速感恰到好处，精准使用快速刹车的感觉非常爽快。相比模拟驾驶，我一直更倾向于街机赛车，尤其是 疯狂出租车 所属的那个时代的风格。在那里，加速极快，到处都散布着等待发掘的捷径，掌握动作和地图几乎成为了一种艺术。虽然我还没能完全找回当年“出租车司机”的直觉，反应速度也比青少年时期慢了一些，但它似乎正走在正确的轨道上，不仅还原了我记忆中老游戏的操作感，连听觉体验也完美契合。

当 The Offspring 乐队的前奏响起，我就像坐进了 Axel 出租车的后座，被带回了 2000 年代初期。那时候我只想放空大脑，四处穿梭，试图打破个人纪录并聆听动感的音乐。开发团队非常清楚 疯狂出租车 与音乐的紧密联系，这让我感到由衷欣慰。我将《All I Want》及其标志性的“YA YA YA”与 疯狂出租车 联系在一起，就像我把 Tony Hawk 与 Goldfinger 的名曲《Superman》联系在一起一样。在 World Tour 中再次听到它，真的让一切都圆满了。
不过，我在虚构德国的时光并不全是沉浸在 90 年代末的滑板朋克音乐和接送乘客中。游戏中还有其他活动，包括各种零工和技能测试，让我在接送乘客之余能稍作休息。当然，这些任务仍然要求快速驾驶，但通常能从典型的点对点运输中带来新鲜感。
在其中一个任务中，我承担了一项重要的环保任务：撞向附近整齐堆放的废纸堆，以便坐在后座、配有吸尘器的工人能把它们全部吸走。不过，我玩得最开心的可能是那个需要我猛踩刹车，让穿着翼装的乘客飞出去，试图挑战最远飞行距离的任务。可惜随后试玩版崩溃了，我不得不停止（不过，这只是预览版本，很正常）。
当我四处飞驰接送乘客、在斜坡上加速跳跃时，尽管玩得很开心，但脑海中总有一个挥之不去的念头，就像驾驶时有一只虫子在耳边嗡嗡作响——这些东西看起来是不是有点……太普通了？虽然出租车本身看起来很帅，但道路上的其他车辆，尤其是 NPC 乘客，缺乏细节和个性，很大程度上给人一种从素材商店直接搬出来的感觉。

事实上，如果不是地图告诉我，或者那些色彩鲜艳的拱形建筑（如果没人告诉我，我会觉得那是“通用的欧洲小镇”），我只会认为这是个随机地点。我希望世嘉能更多地融入当地文化。让乘客带有德国口音，或者偶尔让镇上的居民穿上皮裤（Lederhosen）。我明白现在绝大多数人已经不穿成那样了，但出租车的轮胎也不会喷出绿色火焰。我仍在思考机场的哪些元素能让我觉得身处德国，除了偶尔出现的德语标识（旁边还有英语标识）。如果你不打算在表现风景的同时展现当地人文，那为什么要带玩家环球旅行呢？这是一款开出租车的游戏；如果我在德国开车，我不应该接到德国乘客，或者至少是听起来像德国人的乘客吗？
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260827/XoxuNnbuaFndgph.jpg
尽管如此，即使在目前的早期阶段，当我在德国漂移加速时，我进入了一种宁静祥和的状态，我可以预见自己会连续玩上好几个小时。整个循环虽然简单，但就是很有趣。疯狂出租车 系列之所以被这么多伴随它长大的人所喜爱并期待回归，是有原因的。这一直是我远观的系列，偶尔才会亲自上手，但现在我完全理解了它的魅力。

others.title: Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026: All The Biggest Announcements, Games, And Trailers
gamescom Opening Night Live 2026: Everything Announced

content.v: Gamescom Opening Night Live is here, and once again, we're expecting a bumper night full of new game reveals, gameplay deep-dives, and more from Geoff Keighley's second big show of the year. As usual, we'll be keeping tabs on the event--and the preshow hosted by Kyle Bosman that starts at 10:30 AM PT / 1:30 PM ET--so if you don't have time to sit down for all of the announcements, you can check back here for updates on all the big announcements.

Taking place from the Gamescom showfloor, Gamescom Opening Night Live kicks off at 11 AM PT / 2 PM ET, and Keighley has already dropped a few big game names for this year's edition. Gears of War: E-Day, Metro 2039, and Final Fantasy 7 Revelation are some of the biggest games being shown off, and they'll be joined by new looks at Tides of Annihilation, Ananta, Game of Thrones: War for Westeros, Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons, and The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past.
Worms: Galactic Tactics
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Worms.jpg?w=636

And we're kicking things off with the preshow! Presented by the Final Bosman himself, our first trailer is for a new Worms tactics game that takes a page from the XCOM playbook. It looks like the original Worms is also coming back in some form.
Train Sim World 7
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Train.jpg?w=636
The next chapter in the longrunning Train Sim World series launches on September 15.
Roller Coaster Tycoon Wonderworks
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Rollercoaster-tycoon.jpg?w=636
Think you have what it takes to run the ultimate theme park? You can put your skills to the test when Roller Coaster Tycoon Wonderworks launches in early access soon.
Animo
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Animo.jpg?w=636
Animo looks like it might be getting a visit from The Pokemon Company soon, but until then, the new trailer for the game showed off plenty of cute critters battling each other and one titanic dragon.
Genigods: Nezha
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Genigods.jpg?w=636
An ARPG rooted in ancient Chinese creation mythology, players will take on titanic monsters as the Spirit Pearl, the first being forged by the Goddess of Creation Nüwa.
Perceptum
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Perceptum.jpg?w=636
Need some horror that's all about things that go bump in the night? Perceptum looks like it'll scratch that itch when it launches in 2027.
Acornia: Mirror Worlds
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/cornia.jpg?w=636
This bake-and-brawl management adventure game from Splashteam continues to look adorable, and it's out next year.
Valor Mortis
One more trailer for the upcoming first-person souls-like Valor Mortis from Ghostrunner Studio One More Level, which launches on October 13 for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S.
TankRat
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/TankRat.jpg?w=636
We've got a release date for TankRat, where you'll battle swarms of corrupted mech-monsters from your heavily armed vehicle. It's out on January 17, 2027.
Humankind 2
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Humankind-2.jpg?w=636
The sequel to 2021's Humankind aims to improve on the 4X strategy formula, and once again, players can guide their nation through various eras of human history. It'll be coming to PC in 2027.
Murals

What do centuries-old fables like The Little Mermaid, Rapunzel, and Hansel & Gretel all have in common? Besides the original fiction being nightmare fuel, they're also all featured in Murals, an original IP from Disney Illusion Island developer Dlala Studios. The isometric action-adventure game is set across multiple famous fairy tales, and players will control a nameless hero who must brave dark, twisted takes on these beloved stories.
Age Twisters
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Age-Twisters.jpg?w=636
Age Twisters is a two-player co-op narrative adventure game, where you'll play as a grandfather and granddaughter who team up to solve puzzles. It looks adorable, but it has no release date yet.
Onimusha: Way of the Sword
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/original/123/1239113/4513336-onimusha.jpg?w=636

In case you missed it, there's a demo out there for Onimusha: Way of the Sword. And if you've already played it? Then it's time to boot it up again, as Capcom has added more content to this early--and free--slice of the game.
Mariachi Legends
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Mariachi-Legends.jpg?w=636
I didn't have a Mexican vampire metroidvania on my Gamescom bingo card, but Mariachi Legends is scratching an itch for that very specific scratch I didn't know I had. It launches in April 2027.
Elta: Defy All Gods

Get ready to brawl your way out of corrupted worlds in Elta: Defy All Gods. You've also got an adorable dragon-god companion, free-form melee combat, and fluid platforming, so this might be worth keeping an eye on.
Two hours of game trailers
Two whole hours! We hope you don't need the loo for a while.
Nodus Fall

HoyoVerse made a name for itself with anime-inspired live-service games, but for its next title? It looks like the developer is taking on Elden Ring developer From Software with a high fantasy adventure that looks gorgeous. Called Nodus Fall, players take on the role of a Weaver in this co-op action game.
Rainbow Six Tactics

It's the first brand-new Rainbow Six game in many years! Rainbow Six Tactics. Featuring 15 unique Operators, players will take part in missions across the globe in this XCOM-inspired title. It's out in 2027.
Gears of War: E-Day

After a fun weekend in the Gears of War: E-Day multiplayer beta, the focus is on the story with this new trailer for the game. It's the darkest hour for humanity as Emergence Day leaves cities across Sera ruined, but it looks like humanity isn't ready to go down without a fight. Gears of War: E-Day launches on October 6.
Ananta

NetEase's free-to-play GTA-meets-Spider-Man game Ananta is all about keeping the peace and building a social media empire. It looks wonderfully ridiculous, and it launches on January 15, 2027, for PC and PS5.
Silent Hill Townfall

In case the next few months don't look busy enough, you can try out some small-town Scottish horror in Silent Hill Townfall. The new trailer showed off more of the spooky game in action, and it's the first Silent Hill to be played from a first-person perspective. It's out on September 24.
Resonance: A Plague Tale
The next Plague Tale game is also out soon, and instead of having too many rats, it focuses on puzzles, exploration, and combat.
Sea Remnants
A fresh look at Sea of Remnants next, a pirate-themed RPG with some stylish visuals. I can't say I'm too big a fan of the trailer's use of cheesy country music, though.

items.title: GTA 6 leaker escalates spoilers, releases 4 minutes of Lucia's prologue
items.summary: Cyberleek wants more money.

content.v: The most anticipated game of all time continues to spring leaks. The mysterious Cyberleek , an individual who apparently has access to a build of GTA 6 and has been attempting to profit from it with a meme coin ever since, has released the biggest chunk of the game yet.

This time, it's not just joyrides and beating up random civilians: The 4 minute 38 second clip is all early Lucia story content. This is the first time Lucia, GTA 6's co-lead, has made an appearance in Cyberleek clips, which until today have focused on the other protagonist, Jason.
A message superimposed in the video reads:

"This build is actually recent and the game is not ready at all. Sony and Rockstar are killing your right to own and resell your games and Rockstar is killing their own employees too, the work required to reach gold is way too much for so little time left. Trading volume/price is how CL measures your support. CL will not continue without support. You decide."

It is certainly the most spoilery these leaks have gotten so far, and the escalation seems intentional. Cyberleek seems unsatisfied with the money they're making from the leak spree, and is doubling down on their supposedly altruistic motive while pushing their crypto. Or perhaps Cyberleek can feel the heat of Rockstar's lawyers fast approaching and hopes to squeeze more cash out of the adventure before the book is thrown in their direction.

While you should obviously avoid watching this one if you don't want to know anything about the GTA 6 story going in, I have a feeling Rockstar will reveal a lot more than this about its two main characters during the big Netflix reveal happening tomorrow.

More details about GTA 6's world and mechanics came today in the form of an early preview from youth magazine Dazed, which touched on how food and exercise will affect Jason and Lucia, how character switching works, and Rockstar's dedicated research team embedded in Miami.

联合CEO兼游戏总监Ary Chen表示，团队从一开始就不希望简单复刻完整的亚瑟王神话体系。他表示：“我们希望从中国开发者的视角出发，将其转化为一款奇幻游戏。虽然游戏以亚瑟王传说为基础，但整个故事都经过了我们的重新诠释。”

items.title: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros isn't even out yet and it already feels ancient
items.summary: A by-the-numbers RTS based on a TV show that ended seven years ago.

others.title: Every LEGO Game on the Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 in 2026

content.v: "But why?" That's the question I kept asking myself as I played through a few skirmishes of Game of Thrones: War for Westeros , an RTS based on HBO's TV show. It's a competent, workmanlike creation that nonetheless fails to capture any of what made the show and the books that inspired it such a phenomenon.

It just feels so ill-timed, too. It's not due out until 2027, but Game of Thrones concluded in 2019, with a final season that even GoT defenders such as myself had to acknowledge was a bit of a dud. These days, HBO is busy with its prequels: the plodding but still entertaining House of the Dragon, and the delightful, brisk A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/SLXVbkwDRqa3DmUEFR8CfB.png

Instead of giving us something new, or even current, War for Westeros returns us to the fight for the Iron Throne. You can command a tiny Kit Harrington, listen to narration from Charles Dance, or enjoy a rendition of The Rains of Castamere while you build another mine. These touchpoints are too recent to engender feelings of nostalgia, but not recent enough that they elicit much excitement.

Now, don't get me wrong. GoT provided us with some of the greatest battles to ever grace our TVs. Even as the story went off the rails, the muddy brawls were a sight to behold. There's plenty for an RTS to take advantage of—but this style of RTS fails to play to the strengths of the source material.

GoT's gargantuan pitched battles call to mind the epic scale of Total War—it's no surprise that there are several GoT Total War mods. War for Westeros, meanwhile, has been fashioned in the mould of Age of Empires, or its fantasy cousin, The Battle for Middle-earth 2.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/yaTF8wiXsbUqFwn9gCrfdB.png

You plonk down buildings that generate resources, which you can spend at other buildings that spit out troops or let you research upgrades, and then you send your army to capture territory or boldly torch your opponent's HQ. You can build fortifications and siege engines, but most of your conflicts will be between generic soldiers, sometimes led by heroes drawn from the show's roster of important folk.

It's fine, I guess. There are certainly worse GoT games—most of them on mobile. But War for Westeros is so straightforward and plain that I probably would have had more fun with something uniquely awful. A bawdy brothel management game with Littlefinger, perhaps?

Where Age of Empires had a multitude of bespoke civilisations to play around with, and The Battle for Middle-earth 2 was full of exotic fare like giants and goblins and horrible spiders, War for Westeros is simply full of dudes. Squads of spearmen, squads of swordsmen, slightly smaller squads of elite Night's Watch warriors.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/w86AvQpx6pnwpLVp7fRrdB.png

The full game will feature four factions, but I was only given access to arguably the dullest: the Starks and Lannisters. No dragon-loving Targaryens or hordes of the undead for me. Of the two, the Starks are the most conventional, though they can field direwolves, as well as troops drawn from the Night's Watch and the Free Folk. The Lannisters, meanwhile, are more economy-focused, featuring quirks like a debt mechanic that allows you to quickly fund expansion.

So there's some asymmetry, but that's par for the course. And at least where the Starks and Lannisters are concerned, the asymmetry is broad rather than exciting. It's hard to get pumped about one faction needing to spend a wee bit more gold to recruit their slightly better swordsmen.

OK, maybe I'm being unfair. There are more substantial differences than that. Like being able to recruit both Stark heroes' fluffy pets, which bumps the available heroes up to four (with a fifth locked in the preview build). That's double the Lannisters' roster. There are some more unique units, faction-specific upgrades and special mechanics—but they all fell a bit flat for me. It's all just very, very dry.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/bikjmDo3a9AEF3T4LY6bZB.png

The nature of this type of RTS means that it's never going to give you memorable fights like the Battle of the Bastards or titanic Total War-style clashes, but after a few upgrades you can field some pretty meaty armies and get some big, messy scrums going. The rather plain aesthetic does mean that they aren't always the easiest to read, however, or particularly engaging to watch. That said, I am a fan of the physicality of the cavalry charges, which send any infantry units that get in the way flying.

The big problem is the lack of an obvious hook. This is an extremely conventional RTS, and while the genre isn't especially healthy at the moment, there are still plenty of alternatives. If you're in the market for something fairly traditional, Age of Empires 4, Age of Mythology: Retold or Tempest Rising have a lot more going for them.

The GoT skin is simply not enough to carry it, and there was little that felt uniquely GoT about the skirmishes I played. Perhaps the campaign will inject some much-needed flavour into the proceedings? The more exotic Targaryen and Night King factions might spice things up a bit, too. But so far, it's just very safe and predictable.

items.title: New GTA 6 character swapping details revealed: Jason and Lucia can 'play as a couple, or go off and cause chaos independently'
items.summary: An interview published in Dazed magazine provides some juicy new details about GTA 6's design and development.

content.v: We've got more Grand Theft Auto 6 details to chew on, and this time not from a vegetable . An interview in magazine Dazed has revealed a bunch of details about the design of GTA 6, including how character swapping between protagonists Jason and Lucia works.
We'll get straight into it. Here are the most notable details from the interview:
1. Exercise and diet
Dazed says that food will affect Jason and Lucia's weight, and "exercising visibly builds and tones their muscles." Playing for long periods without sleeping will also impact their appearance.

Rockstar has played around with these life sims systems in past games—most recently in Red Dead Redemption 2, where Arthur could gain or lose weight based on his diet. GTA hasn't had systems this granular since 2004's GTA: San Andreas, in which CJ could gain weight and lose it through working out.
2. Character swapping

The way GTA 6 handles multiple playable characters will differ from GTA 5. The Dazed preview notes that you can "choose to either play as a couple, or go off and cause chaos independently." They described a scenario where you can cruise along the highway as Jason, then swap to Lucia in the passenger seat to "scroll on the in-game phone."
That sounds, to me, like GTA 6 will have a dynamic 'couple mode' for open world roaming—in keeping with this being a love story—but missions themselves might be solo or together.
3. Rockstar's team size

According to Dazed, Rockstar has massively expanded its team and resources to get all the details in GTA 6 right. The studio has more than doubled in size since Red Dead Redemption 2. It has an office in LA dedicated to the pedestrian NPCs that fill the open world. It also brought in over 50 real world street artists to help design the murals for GTA 6's version of Wynwood, Miami's outdoor art galleries, and there's a team of actual race car drivers handling the vehicle physics.
4. Expect to see a variety of Florida Men
Per Dazed: "Players can expect encounters with virtual iterations of Florida Man, the cultural archetype-turned-meme known IRL for wrangling alligators, drunken antics, and literal grand theft auto."
5. On music
Regarding GTA 6's music, senior vice president of narrative Ruper Humphries told Dazed:

"We love Miami music, particularly Miami bass, going through to more recent Miami artists like Kodak Black and Sexyy Red. We were also really interested in how the hip-hop scene in Miami exists in house parties in Overtown, clubs like Booby Trap on the River, and then high-end places on South Beach where bottles can cost thousands of dollars. We needed characters who could take us through those worlds."
6. Jason and Lucia's backgrounds
The preview notes that Jason is ex-military and a drug runner. Lucia is an amateur fighter (as seen in trailers) fresh out of prison.
7. Choices
Dazed suggests that player choices or behavior will affect Jason and Lucia's relationship in ways that "cut much deeper than Rockstar’s previous titles or 'honour' systems."

items.title: The Frosthaven Board Game Gets a Rare Discount on Amazon

content.v: Frosthaven is one of the best board games on the market. It served as a follow up to the immensely popular Gloomhaven board game, and is one of the most imposing dungeon-delving board games you can buy. It's also really quite expensive.

It's not often that we see any sort of discount on this game, but Amazon currently has a Lightning Deal running that drops it down to its lowest price ever. For a limited time (or while stock lasts), you can pick up this massive board game for $153. The discount is set to expire around 7:45pm PT or when the deal is fully claimed.

Frosthaven comes as an enormous box full of stuff. There's an incredibly thick rulebook, decks of cards, trays, dividers, a map, and miniatures. All-in-all, there are a few hundred hours worth of gameplay that comes packaged in a rather large box. And if you already own Gloomhaven characters and items, you can use them in this game as well. It's a massive campaign game that can be pretty daunting for casual players.
What We Said in Our Review
We gave Frosthaven a 9 out of 10 in our review , with the caveat that you may want to jump into Jaws of the Lion first if you're a newcomer. Here's what we had to say about the game:

"Weirdly, although Frosthaven improves on its predecessor in almost every respect, it’s far harder to recommend. Its sheer weight and the glory of the game that came before it holds it back. If you’re a Gloomhaven fan but you haven’t yet finished working your way through that behemoth of a box it’s better to stick with what you know for now rather than start a new project. If you’re new to the entire franchise then you should absolutely jump into that brilliant combat and exploration engine but the cut-down Jaws of the Lion is a better introduction. If you’re one of the rare few who not only have seen everything Gloomhaven has to offer but also remain hungry for more, however, Frosthaven is the banquet to satiate you. Bigger, bolder and better than the original, if you can find time for it in your life it’s an epic gaming experience like no other." - Matt Thrower

items.title: The Expanse’s Most Iconic Foe Shows Up In Osiris Reborn’s New Trailer
items.summary: Owlcat Games has given players a new look at its upcoming sci-fi RPG based on The Expanse. The latest trailer

content.v: Owlcat Games has given players a new look at its upcoming sci-fi RPG based on The Expanse. The latest trailer for The Expanse: Osiris Reborn aired during Gamescom 's Find Your Next Game showcase, giving players a better look at Owlcat's take on one of the TV show's most frightening foes: Project Caliban .

In The Expanse TV show (and the books upon which it is based), Project Caliban is a top-secret experiment run by a company called Protogen, which hopes to harness the recently discovered Protomolecule to create supersoldiers. Unsurprisingly, the results are tragic—and terrifying. Based on the trailer, Osiris Reborn players will be facing off with both Protogen's hired guns and one of Project Caliban's many unfortunate human test subjects, who has taken the form of a human-Protomolecule hybrid, just like the one shown in Season 2 of The Expanse TV show.

When it comes to the Protomolecule's appearance, it seems that Owlcat is taking inspiration from the television show rather than the book series--in the show, the Protomolecule is a bright, glowing blue; in the books it's described as a slimy, brownish substance rather than the bioluminescent blue seen in the latest Osiris Reborn trailer.

The new trailer also provides a better look at a female version of the player-character (simply called "the Captain" in-game) as she explores the Protogen facility on Ganymede. Osiris Reborn players can also choose to play as a male character, but after complaints about the original male player-character's voice acting surfaced in the wake of the game's April 2026 beta test, Owlcat Games has recast the role of the male lead (which is likely why we don't hear a word from him in this trailer).

The Expanse: Osiris Reborn does not yet have a specific release date, but is expected to launch for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S sometime in Q2 2027. It is currently available to wishlist on Steam .

items.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Will Have RPG Mechanics Like Eating, Exercising, and More
items.summary: Some of the first gameplay details for Grand Theft Auto 6 have been confirmed, and it seems like Rockstar is e

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/26/gta-6-raul-1787763525044.jpg
Some of the first gameplay details for Grand Theft Auto 6 have been confirmed, and it seems like Rockstar is embracing a more RPG-type style this time around.

As part of a cover story for Dazed magazine , Rockstar Games revealed heaps of new information about Grand Theft Auto 6. Arguably the most notable details revolve around some of its gameplay features. In GTA 6, players will be able to eat, work out, and sleep, all of which have an impact on the game's two protagonists, Jason and Lucia. Players will have to take care of the Bonnie and Clyde-esque couple, as eating will affect their weight, working out will visibly change their build and strength, and a lack of sleep will negatively impact their features. It's unclear if a lack of sleep will impact the actual gameplay, or if they'll just look sleep-deprived, but it's a clear sign of Rockstar's attention to detail.

For many, this may remind them of Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas. That game featured a lot of RPG mechanics that allowed CJ to fluctuate in weight and fitness. Later games largely dropped these elements, but GTA 5 featured a stat system that allowed players to enhance their stamina and strength by doing physical activities such as running, playing sports, and riding bikes.

Additionally, there is also a social media feed for players to scroll, something fans have speculated about since the game's reveal in 2023. Character switching is also returning from GTA 5, allowing players to play as a couple or split up and operate independently. Dazed teased that the relationship between these two is a major focus of the game and that choices made by the player have "repercussions that cut much deeper" than the honor system in the Red Dead Redemption series.

“We look back at our previous games with a critical eye and see where we want to evolve based on what we didn’t do as well as we would have liked to, either because we didn’t have the time, resources or technological capabilities, or in some cases things we just didn’t do as well or consider as fully as we could have,” said Rob Nelson, co-studio head at Rockstar North. “A lot of what we do is very iterative — we adjust a lot of things by feel based on what is working and what isn’t.”

Based on that information, it's possible that there will be some kind of relationship meter that can impact how Jason and Lucia feel about each other. Ultimately, it sounds like Rockstar is making a much more nuanced and interactive game. That should hardly come as a surprise following Red Dead Redemption 2, but it seems like Rockstar is really pushing the envelope with GTA 6. Tomorrow, fans will get a proper look at the game thanks to an extended look releasing on Netflix at 3 PM ET , with a YouTube version to follow six hours later.

GTA 6 has suffered from a plethora of leaks over the last week, including a story-focused one earlier today . Rockstar Games released a statement this morning confirming that the situation was "heartbreaking," but it is working hard to deliver a product that exceeds expectations.
Grand Theft Auto 6 will release on November 19th for Xbox Series X|S and PS5.

items.summary: Legendary actor Tim Curry has died, aged 80. The star of the Rocky Horror Picture Show, the English actor was

content.v: Legendary actor Tim Curry has died, aged 80. The star of the Rocky Horror Picture Show, the English actor was also celebrated for his work in the recording booth, bringing dozens of animated series and video game characters to life-- including a scene-stealing performance as Premier Anatoly Cherdenko in Command & Conquer: Red Alert 3.

While a cause of death hasn't been revealed, it is worth noting that Curry had been battling various health issues after he had a major stroke in 2012. The English actor dealt with short-term memory and mobility issues following this, although he continued to work in the entertainment industry.

Film roles like Darkness in Legend, the concierge in Home Alone 2: Lost in New York, Pennywise in Stephen King's It, and Long John Silver in Muppet Treasure Island cemented his role as a Hollywood legend, and he was also a regular on several TV series throughout the decades. Curry regularly appeared on stage--including a memorable performance as King Arthur in Spamalot--and he even released several albums.
For many fans, Curry will be forever immortalized for his plans to escape to the one place uncorrupted by capitalism: SPACE!

Curry's death is sadly the latest in the entertainment industry, as country singer Dolly Parton also passed away this week, and last week, Nashville star Hayden Panettiere's death sent shockwaves when it was announced.

items.summary: Everything about the studio's new game is different.

content.v: If you watched the Nodusfall trailer during Gamescom's Opening Night Live and, like me, thought the combo of Elden Ring's aesthetic and Monster Hunter's fights sounded awesome, but were worried about selling your soul to the god of gacha, fret not!
Nodusfall isn't just a visual departure for HoYoverse, swapping the vibrant anime aesthetic for something gloomier, it also represents a (partial) change in business model.

According to the devs, "Nodusfall will be a free-to-play, long-term game. What we can share at this time is that characters are not obtained through random draws. We hope to allow players to unlock this core gameplay experience through continued play. Cosmetic monetization is an important avenue we will be considering."

In my hands-on, the four available characters could be customised with different outfits, hairstyles and accessories, and I can imagine folk dropping some cash on some new fits for their boss-slaying crew, but it's a relief to know that I won't need to go through RNG hell or wipe out my bank account just to play as a surly warrior who can transform into a dual-wielding giant.

Gamescom is absolutely full of the typical anime cast gacha games this year, so it's a pleasant surprise to see the studio best known for them trying something a wee bit different. It feels different, too. Not like Genshin or Zenless Zone Zero, but not exactly like Elden Ring or Monster Hunter, despite them both being obvious inspirations. The fights are a bit more forgiving, for one, and also snappier and more fast-paced.

I've only just finished sending a trio of bosses back to whatever afterlife they go to, so I've still gotta digest what I played, but Nodusfall definitely makes a great first impression. Check back in the next couple of days for my full hands-on preview.

items.title: I added a gang notoriety system to GTA 5, but it mostly seems to make them murder everyone except me
items.summary: Which, you know, is positive I guess.

content.v: It's kind of strange that the state monopoly on violence is the only gang you can start an even slightly lasting beef with in Grand Theft Auto 5. Real-life gangs aren't known for their live-and-let-live attitude, and yet if you stroll around town shooting Ballas and Cartel members, they will adopt a stance of Christ-like forgiveness the second you're out of eyesight. The cops at least will spend a little time hunting you before they give up.

This is what I aimed to fix when I installed Gang Notoriety into my tottering Jenga tower of GTA 5 mods. The pitch is simple: gangs will get sustainably angry with you now, accruing wanted stars much like the cops do until you manage to lose the heat.
To test this new facet of GTA 5's rich simulation, I teleported (I can teleport now) to Grove Street and began shooting.

It sort of worked? The minimap blossomed with a thousand red and orange rings—each denoting a gang member who was very cross with me and ready to do something about it. I got a wanted star, too. Whether that was the gang's wanted star or just regular cops being upset about me shooting people in the street? Hard to say.

But things quickly got weird. Before too long, the assembled Ballas of Grove Street started to lose interest in me and started to gain interest in… each other? They ducked behind cover and started attacking each other, and at some point one loosed a rottweiler, which just seemed rather confused by the entire situation. Meanwhile, the frictionless vehicles of Los Santos continued to wheel all about us, including in the sky.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/TEg7PusxN4bENho7hEDX8C.gif

Though my minimap was still red, everyone had lost interest in me. The Ballas seemed to have become notorious among the Ballas. They all eventually took care of themselves, save the sole survivor, who had quite the wanted level himself, thanks to a previous mod.
I will get back to you when I figure out the moral of this story.

items.title: God help us, they overclocked Mega Man
items.summary: That's going to void a warranty for sure.

content.v: Even if Mega Man's been out of Capcom's spotlight for a few years now, there's still been something refreshingly reliable about his presence. Sure, he might get a leaf shield or a throwing saw sometimes depending on which of his machine-kin he's forced to cull, but by and large, his capabilities are easy to wrap your hand around: He has an arm cannon, and you can charge it. It's predictable. It's safe. It's comfortable.
So what the hell is that?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/GAb8M8hQT4it8VYKvmGbCb.png

During last night's Gamescom Opening Night Live, Capcom released its first glimpse of gameplay for Mega Man: Dual Override, the first entry in the classic Mega Man lineup since 2018. And it's with the appropriate gravity that I'm forced to report: They've gone and overclocked Mega Man.

According to Capcom, Dual Override has Mega Man "overriding his limits and powering up for a new adventure" by using "new Custom Chips to freely modify and enhance your abilities" and an Override system that can "unleash overwhelming power for a limited time." In other words, someone thought it would be a good idea to crank up the voltage on our sweet android son beyond the recommended manufacturer guidelines.

The results, I'll admit, seem pretty effective: In the gameplay trailer embedded above, Mega Man's aftermarket mods can let him shoot a barrage of damaging projectiles, hover over platforming hazards, and dash around enemies for a more advantageous shooting position.

I can't help but notice, however, that after deploying those modifications, he's forced to expose his visibly incandescent heatsinks to avoid overheating. There's even a moment late in the footage where he pulls a Unicorn Gundam and enters Destroy Mode, exposing all his available cooling surfaces to fire a massively overcharged shot that—to his credit—insta-KOs a boss. But it also leaves him sparking and billowing smoke.
This just seems irresponsible during a hardware shortage crisis, is all I'm saying.
We don't have a precise release date for Mega Man: Dual Override yet, but it's set to launch sometime in 2027. You can wishlist it on Steam now.

items.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's Beta Will Be Playable on Switch 2 for Free This Weekend
items.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 will be playable on Nintendo Switch 2 for free this weekend.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/26/mw4-switch-2-1787760327779.jpg
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 will be playable on Nintendo Switch 2 for free this weekend.

Starting Friday, August 28 at 10 AM PDT, Nintendo Switch 2 players will have the opportunity to try Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 for free. The beta's second weekend will kick off, giving Nintendo fans the opportunity to try a level from the game's campaign, multiplayer, and even the battle royale, Warzone.

The Switch 2 version will boast unique features such as gyro controls, Joy-Con mouse controls, and, of course, being able to play the game on a handheld. Additionally, Switch 2 players will get free access to the game's Vault Edition content during the beta. This includes access to special skins, weapon blueprints, and more. Players can pre-load the beta on Switch 2 right now and pre-order the full game.

It's the first time a Call of Duty game has been on a Nintendo platform since Call of Duty: Ghosts on Wii U. Nintendo fans have been wanting to see the franchise return to Nintendo hardware since then, but it hasn't been feasible until now. Digital Legends are developing the game's Switch 2 version after having helped develop Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile before its cancelation. The studio also did support work on the last two Black Ops games.

"For the first time in more than a decade, Call of Duty is back on a Nintendo platform, and we’re incredibly proud that Digital Legends has partnered with Infinity Ward to make it happen with Modern Warfare 4, said Xavier Carrillo-Costa, studio head, Digital Legends. "Our goal has been simple from day one: deliver the genuine Call of Duty experience on Nintendo Switch 2. Players can enjoy the full intensity, authenticity, and quality of Modern Warfare 4 wherever they are, whether at home or on the move."

In 2023, Microsoft signed a legally binding deal with Nintendo to bring Call of Duty games to Nintendo platforms for a decade with full feature parity. That means there's no missing content or notable concessions made to bring Call of Duty to Switch 2. Whether Nintendo fans show up for this release remains to be seen, but it's great to see Switch 2 being supported more and more by the biggest third-party franchises out there.
Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

content.v: Have you ever looked at your cat and thought, 'I bet they'd love Metal Gear Solid'. Well, if you have, then not only does your cat have impeccable taste, but you can share in the hobby with these new MGS-themed cat toys. Just not at Gamescom.

No, unfortunately, for everyone wandering through the Koelnmesse right now, Konami is bringing its set of MGS cat gear to CatCon 2026 instead, the "world's largest cat-centric pop-up event—ok, I guess that makes more sense than Cologne. Fans will be able to pick up plushie pet toys, cat collars inspired by Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker and Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots , and scratch boxes both online and at the booth from October 10-11.

But those who make it to the booth will also get the added benefit of meeting Uno the one-eared cat, who Konami aptly names a 'cat-fluencer'. I'm not the biggest fan of influencers, but I'll make an exception for Uno because she looks very polite. "Uno and Kat featured in a special playthrough video of Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2 where they revealed the specialty cardboard cat boxes."

I don't even have a cat and I want to get one of these—they actually look surprisingly good for videogame merch. So I guess the next logical step is to get a cat and then find one of those scratch boxes. But for now I guess I'll just add it to my cat-centric video game items, somewhere between the cat-themed PC case and the fluffy cat keyboard .

This is just one way in which Konami plans to celebrate the release of Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Vol. 2, which comes out tomorrow August 27. But honestly, I think I'm more excited for the cat scratch boxes now.

items.title: 6 indie.io Games Coming to gamescom and PAX West That Have Free Demos on Steam

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/monster-park-tycoon-key-art-1787604509317.png

Publishing platform indie.io will be on hand at gamescom and PAX West in the coming weeks, and it’s bringing six games for people to try out in person. But if you’re not one of the lucky people who can be there yourself, don’t worry: all six games have free demos you can play on Steam right now, no badge or ticket required.

As tends to be the case with indie.io, their selection of games covers a wide range of genres. There’s everything from a cozy vineyard château builder to a brutal turn-based roguelite RPG. There’s a little something for all kinds of gamers, and you can try out all of them right now.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/monster-park-tycoon-key-art-1787602371901.png
Monster Park Tycoon

If you watched IGN’s recent Indie Loop showcase, you would have seen this game under another name. Formerly called Monster Zoo Tycoon, it unveiled its new name on August 10, but the dev team and core gameplay remain the same. In Monster Park Tycoon from developer OverPowered Team, you build and manage a monster park where visitors can come see a variety of strange and terrifying abominations. But there’s a twist: your park is a front for a cult. Not a very smart cult, at that.

In order to expand your park, you’ll need to trick and capture your guests using traps disguised as park props. Once you’ve got them, you can either feed them to your monsters, brainwash them to turn them into cultists, or sacrifice them to gain Faith and unlock favors from your Dark Lord.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/monster-park-tycoon-screenshot-1787602371901.jpg

Different monsters require different diets (like brains, blood, or souls), conditions for their exhibits, and behaviors that can become an issue if you ignore them. As your number of monsters grows, it’s inevitable that some of them will break free of their confinement, which is when all hell breaks loose. So you’ll have to control the chaos as you try to grow both your park and your cult in this darkly funny management sim.
Monster Park Tycoon has a brand-new demo available on Steam that marks the first time anyone outside the dev team has been able to play it.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/dunebound-tactics-key-art-1787602371900.png
Dunebound Tactics

In this roguelite, you’ll engage in tactical turn-based combat as you try to lead a band of survivors across a perilous desert in search of a new home. Your ship is fragile and your access to an all-important resource called Elios is limited. As you travel across the dunes, you’ll gather Elios from quests, from the bodies of defeated enemies, or if things get truly desperate, from sacrificing your crew members.

This is a roguelite, so you’re expected to fail. A lot. But each run builds on the ones before it. Each time a caravan is destroyed, you’ll start again with a new one. But you can find the wreck of the previous caravan, which can reward you with modules to empower your crew or even survivors who were part of your previous run.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/dunebound-tactics-screenshot-1787602371900.png

Your crew has a roster of 15 classes with 16 unique traits that determine their skills, stats, and abilities. Combat takes place on a grid, where cover is available but the terrain is fully destructible. So you can mold that terrain to your advantage and use it to outwit your enemies.

Dunebound Tactics was featured during Steam Next Fest, and afterward its demo was rebuilt based on player feedback. In developer Terahard Ltd.’s own words, “If you haven’t played the demo recently, it’s not the demo you remember.” You can play the new and improved demo on Steam .
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/we-took-that-trip-key-art-1787602371901.png
We Took That Trip

Quite a tonal departure from the first two entries on this list, We Took That Trip from developer Lucito Loquito is a calm and relaxing road trip game. There are no timers or deadlines, no great quest that needs to be completed. It’s just you and your cat traveling in a van and meeting new people.

There are three game modes to choose from: Story, Zen, and Background. Story Mode tells a heartwarming tale of friendship, loss, and reunion. Zen is just about the vibe, going for a ride with no real goal in mind. And Background is an AFK mode that takes care of the driving for you, so you can just enjoy the visuals and lo-fi soundtrack.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/we-took-that-trip-screenshot-1787602371901.png

Each trip is procedurally generated and lasts as long as you choose, so every trip is different. There are points of interest scattered across your route, like gas stations, stores, and lookout towers, where you’ll meet people and hear their stories. But the focus is always the road and your Microbus, which you customize both the interior and exterior of with paint, stickers, and other decorations.
If you’re looking for a peaceful way to de-stress after a long day, you can check out the demo on Steam .
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/cozy-builder-key-art-1787602371900.png
Cozy Builder

The peaceful vibes continue with the aptly named Cozy Builder, a sandbox building sim from Pangea Game Studios where you’ll start from scratch and restore Vineyard Valley to its former glory. You’ll use modular architectural pieces to create your château and harvest grapes, herbs, and wildflowers to create your own wines and other goods to share with the townsfolk or sell to continue funding your château.

There are tons of customization options for your château, including a variety of artwork and furniture for the interior and gardens, terraces, and greenhouses for the exterior. You can connect the greenhouse to your home, giving you a place to nurture flowers and collect rare plants.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/cozy-builder-screenshot-1787602371900.jpg

You can do all of this solo or build a shared space with your friends in multiplayer, giving each of you the chance to show off your creativity. The demo has been getting updated throughout the summer to add new features, like one-click item moving in destruct mode and full key rebinding. You can try it out for yourself on Steam .
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/mayday-the-survival-island-key-art-1787602371901.png
Mayday: The Survival Island

This open-world survival crafting game from developer Pequi Studios sees you wake up alone on an island after a mysterious crash. You’re injured, disoriented, and surrounded by untamed wilderness, so you’ll have to find a way to sustain yourself and survive. To do that, you’ll need to gather resources, craft tools, hunt wild animals, catch fish, grow crops, and build a homestead that can sustain you while you try to figure out what happened to you.

As it turns out, the island you washed up on is one of 24 that make up an archipelago, and your adventure will take you to all of them, each of which has different environments, resources, and hidden treasures. So you’ll need to continuously upgrade your tools and figure out how to adapt to each island’s challenges.
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/mayday-the-survival-island-screenshot-1787602371901.jpg

There aren’t any timed objectives or linear paths, so you decide the pace at which the story unfolds. If you want to spend hours building up your base, raising animals, and tending crops, you can do that. Or you can just find what you need to keep surviving and move on to the next part of the story, it’s up to you.

That story of Mayday: The Survival Island is focused on the mysteries of the island and how you ended up there. You’ll find strange symbols, magical totems, and fragments of a lost civilization that hint these islands are more than meets the eye. And the more you explore, the more you’ll question if ending up here was an accident and if escape is even possible. You can get a taste of all this with the free Steam demo .
